description: Land Acquisition - Elalla Village, Hambanthota D/S Division, Hambanthota District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act. It provides detailed descriptions of specific land lots being acquired by the government for public purposes, including lot numbers, land names, descriptions of use, claimants, and exact land extents. The content falls under "Land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) classification criteria.
